company.name: Outschool
company.shortDescription: Outschool is a marketplace of live online classes for kids that connects learners, parents, and teachers together.
company.description:
Outschool connects motivated learners, parents, and teachers together to create great learning experiences. Their mission is to build the biggest and best global school by offering unique online classes from hundreds of independent teachers. Outschool teachers may be certified teachers, artists, scientists, or other adults with expertise or interest in teaching.

It was founded in 2015 and is based in San Francisco, California.

insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series D round raised $110,000,000, or 45.79% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $2,941,195 to $3,000,000,000, a 1019.99x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
